description: This file defines an interface for recipe persistence and an in-memory implementation of that interface, including methods for CRUD operations and search functionality.

classes.name: InMemoryRecipeRepository
classes.description: An in-memory implementation of the IRecipeRepository interface, managing a list of recipes with CRUD operations and seeding initial data.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Returns all recipes ordered by the most recently updated.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a recipe by its unique identifier.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for recipes that match the query in title, ingredients, tags, or instructions.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new recipe to the in-memory collection.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing recipe identified by its Id.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes a recipe by its Id.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Checks whether a recipe exists by its Id.

methods.name: Seed
methods.description: Initializes the repository with predefined recipes.
